# The Rules in One Place {#the-instructions}

This page is for the man who has taken the final step. If you haven't yet, your only instruction is to keep reading. The method fits in two words: decide and rejoice. These twelve spell it out.

1. Follow every instruction. All of them.
2. Keep your mind open.
3. Begin glad. You're being let out, so don't mope.
4. Ignore advice to count days, cut down or "moderate". Never ignore your doctor, your counselor or your pastor.
5. Refuse every stopgap and every substitute.
6. Get it straight: lust gives you no pleasure and no support. You are giving up nothing.
7. Don't wait for a better day. You stopped at the final step. Stay stopped.
8. You said your plain No. Never reopen the question.
9. "Just once" does not exist.
10. Never go back. Not to the porn, not to the hand, and not to the chase.
11. Stay close to God. Pray, read the Bible, and be part of a church. You aren't guarding a door. You're getting to know the one who opened it. If you're not a believer, stay close to the people who make you want to be this man.
12. You are fit for service now. Go back for one man, and hand him this book.

## Verses for the moment {-}

Many methods close with affirmations. This one uses older words. Pick one or two, learn them by heart, and say them aloud when the Little Monster stirs. If you're not a believer, borrow them anyway. They will serve you better than a slogan.

> "For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace."
>
> — Romans 6:14

> "Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me."
>
> — Psalm 51:10

> "Let's therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need."
>
> — Hebrews 4:16

> "If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed."
>
> — John 8:36
